title: Do, Don't, Doesn't
intro: Kalimat positif memakai kata kerja biasa (I eat, She eats). Untuk kalimat negatif: I, you, we, they + don't + kata kerja dasar; he, she, it + doesn't + kata kerja dasar. Setelah doesn't, kata kerja kehilangan -s.

exercises.question: She ___ like durian.
exercises.explanation: 'She' memakai doesn't. Kata kerja setelahnya tetap bentuk dasar: like.

exercises.question: We ___ watch TV.
exercises.explanation: 'We' memakai don't + kata kerja dasar: don't watch.

exercises.question: Pick the correct negative sentence.
exercises.explanation: 'She' memakai doesn't, dan setelah doesn't kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar: like, bukan likes.

exercises.prompt: Match each subject to don't or doesn't
exercises.explanation: I, you, we, dan they memakai don't. He, she, it, dan orang tunggal seperti 'my sister' memakai doesn't.
He + doesn't + kata kerja dasar. 'Writes' kehilangan -s: doesn't write.

answer: They don't watch TV at night.
They do not watch TV at night.
exercises.explanation: 'They' memakai don't + kata kerja dasar: don't watch.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence using the words in brackets
exercises.explanation: 'My friend' berarti he atau she, jadi doesn't + kata kerja dasar: doesn't like.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence using the words in brackets
exercises.explanation: 'I' memakai don't + kata kerja dasar: don't eat.

exercises.question: Pick the correct negative sentence.
options: He doesn't go to school on Sunday.
He doesn't goes to school on Sunday.
He don't goes to school on Sunday.
exercises.answer: He doesn't go to school on Sunday.
exercises.explanation: Setelah doesn't, kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar: go, bukan goes.
